Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

Got questions? We've got answers. Here's everything you need to know before your free qualification call.

What credit score do I need to qualify? ▾
We work with clients across a wide range of credit scores. During your free qualification call, we'll evaluate your complete financial profile and identify the best funding options available to you — even if your credit isn't perfect.
How long does the funding process take? ▾
Most clients receive funding within 2–4 weeks of completing their qualification call. The exact timeline depends on your specific situation and the type of funding you're pursuing.
What types of funding are available? ▾
We help you access business lines of credit, personal credit lines, business loans, SBA loans, and specialized funding for real estate investors. We'll match you with the best options for your goals.
Do I need an established business to qualify? ▾
Not necessarily. We work with startups, new businesses, and established companies alike. We also help individuals build personal credit profiles for future business ventures.
Is there any cost for the qualification call? ▾
The qualification call is 100% free with no obligations. It's designed to help you understand your funding potential and create a clear path forward.
What if I've been denied funding before? ▾
Many of our most successful clients came to us after being denied elsewhere. We specialize in finding alternative pathways and building stronger credit profiles that lead to approvals.
How is this different from going to a bank? ▾
Banks typically offer limited options and strict requirements. We have access to multiple funding sources and can match you with lenders who specialize in your specific situation, increasing your approval odds significantly.
What industries do you work with? ▾
We work with clients across all industries including real estate, retail, professional services, e-commerce, construction, healthcare, and more. Our strategies apply to virtually any business type.
